notes.title: SimCity 4 modders are cracking its deepest recesses in ever greater numbers, enabling extensive new changes
notes.notes:
SimCity 4 modders are making previously-unheard-of DLL plugins and mods due to recent advances, enabling changes of tweaks to how it runs that prior modders would have considered impossible. Over the past few months these types of deep, game-altering mods, previously restricted to just a couple famous examples, have proliferated into dozens of tweaks to quality of life and brand new game features...
                Read more.

notes.title: New Release - SimCity 4 Deluxe Edition
notes.notes:
Now you can enjoy all the excitement of SimCity 4 on Steam!

Get SimCity 4 and SimCity 4 Rush Hour in one convenient package. Create, grow, and breathe life into your ideal urban environment. Fight disasters both realistic and fantastic. Govern your own virtual metropolis as you see fit.
